bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for the interchange reconstruction project at U.S. Highway 169 and Hennepin County State-Aid Highway 130.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$12,300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the trunk highway fund to the commissioner of transportation for predesign, right-of-way acquisition, design, engineering, and construction of capacity and safety improvements to the interchange at U.S. Highway 169 and Hennepin County State-Aid Highway 130 in Maple Grove. This appropriation does not require a nonstate match. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027.
